Alpaca Dental Clinic
has two branches:
Bang Sue and Kray.

***Parking at the Bang Sue branch:
If you're driving or riding a motorcycle,
park in the parking lot
in Soi Phatthana.

The soi is just before the clinic,
right next to it.
It's Soi Phatthana/ a bubble tea supply shop/ and the clinic.

It's a single-lane soi.
When turning into the soi,
drive slowly and be careful of oncoming traffic.

In front of the clinic is a motorcycle taxi stand
+ a bus stop.
**(Important) Do not park in front of the clinic as it will encroach on the motorcycle taxi area.

There's an elderly gentleman watching the parking lot.
Tell him you're here for dental treatment,
and you'll get free parking.

For those going to the Khaerai branch:
Park your car at Lotus Khaerai.

I'd like to say that I was personally impressed with the care at Alpaca Clinic.
The staff provided excellent after-service.
They called to inquire about my condition after the dental treatment.
And they also called to remind me of my appointment the day before.

You can also inquire about the treatment costs; the staff were happy to answer all questions.
